senses.gloss: m. (זָמַר II) music, song; כלי ז׳ (or sub. כלי) musical instrument.
units: <cite ref="Sotah 48a:20">Sot. 48ᵃ</cite> <he>בארבעה מיני ז׳</he> to the music of four instruments. Y. ib. VII, 21ᶜ top <he>לעז לז׳</he> Greek is adapted for song; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 1:9:3">Y. Meg. I, 71ᵇ</cite> bot.—

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 101a:2">Snh. 101ᵃ</cite> <he>ועושה אותו כמין ז׳</he> and treats it (a verse of Song of Songs) like a (secular) song; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 953:7">Yalk. Prov. 953</cite>; a. fr.
